tagline.en: A Wisconsin-only route assembled from two unrelated freeways
tagline.zh: 全程仅在威斯康星，由两条无关的高速拼成

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.en: I-39 and I-90 at Beloit, Wisconsin
start.zh: 威斯康星州伯洛伊特，与 I-39、I-90 相接

end.en: I-41 and US 141 in Green Bay, Wisconsin
end.zh: 威斯康星州格林贝，与 I-41、US 141 相接

en: I-43 lies entirely within Wisconsin and is really two roads that share a number. The northern leg runs up the Lake Michigan shore from Milwaukee through Port Washington, Sheboygan and Manitowoc to Green Bay. The southern leg runs inland southwest from the Milwaukee suburbs through Waukesha and Janesville to Beloit on the Illinois line.

The two do not meet directly. Between them the number is carried along other Interstates through Milwaukee — south from downtown on the North–South Freeway alongside I-94, then west on I-894 — so a driver following I-43 end to end spends part of the trip on pavement signed with two or three numbers at once.
Neither leg was in the original 1956 plan. Both were built as other things and given the number later, which is why the route's shape looks less like a corridor than like an administrative decision.
zh: I-43 完全位于威斯康星州境内，实际上是共用一个编号的两条路。北段沿密歇根湖岸自密尔沃基北上，经华盛顿港、希博伊根、马尼托沃克抵达格林贝。南段则自密尔沃基郊区向西南深入内陆，经沃基肖、詹斯维尔到达伊利诺伊州界上的伯洛伊特。
两段并不直接相接。中间这个编号是借道密尔沃基的其他州际公路串起来的——先沿南北快速路与 I-94 并行南下，再沿 I-894 西行——所以从头开到尾的司机，会有一段路走在同时标着两三个编号的路面上。
两段都不在 1956 年的原始规划之内。它们各自以别的身份建成，编号是后来才给的，这就是为什么这条路线的形状看上去不像一条走廊，倒像一项行政决定。

en: The northern leg came first. It was built as a freeway upgrade of US 141 between Milwaukee and Green Bay, opening northward in stages through the late 1960s and 1970s. I-43 appeared on it in 1975, running from the Marquette Interchange in downtown Milwaukee north to Sheboygan, and US 141 began disappearing from the corridor almost immediately. The run to Green Bay was finished in 1981.

The southern leg was built as a state highway with no Interstate ambitions. Construction of the Rock Freeway between Beloit and the Milwaukee area began in 1969 and finished in 1976, signed as State Trunk Highway 15.

In November 1987 the route numbering committee approved Wisconsin's request to give the Rock Freeway an Interstate designation, extending I-43 south from downtown Milwaukee over I-94, west over I-894, and then southwest over STH 15 to I-90 at Beloit. STH 15 was decommissioned by the same action and I-43 markers went up during 1988.
zh: 北段先建成。它是密尔沃基至格林贝之间 US 141 的高速化改造，1960 年代末至 1970 年代分段向北通车。1975 年，I-43 编号出现在这条路上，自密尔沃基市中心的马凯特立交北至希博伊根，US 141 几乎立刻开始从这条走廊上消失。通往格林贝的路段 1981 年完工。
南段建成时只是一条州公路，并无跻身州际公路之意。伯洛伊特至密尔沃基地区的「岩河快速路」1969 年开工，1976 年建成，标为 15 号州干道。
1987 年 11 月，路线编号委员会批准了威斯康星把岩河快速路纳入州际公路编号的请求，将 I-43 自密尔沃基市中心沿 I-94 南下、沿 I-894 西行，再沿 STH 15 西南行至伯洛伊特的 I-90。同一决定撤销了 STH 15 编号，I-43 的标志于 1988 年陆续竖起。

why.en: No public figure exists. Neither leg was built as an I-43 project: the northern half was a US 141 freeway upgrade completed over roughly fifteen years, the southern half was built as State Trunk Highway 15, and the number was applied to both afterwards.
why.zh: 无公开数据。两段都不是作为 I-43 项目修建的：北半段是历时约十五年完成的 US 141 高速化改造，南半段建成时是 15 号州干道，编号是事后才加上去的。

value.en: 187.8 miles, all of it in Wisconsin
value.zh: 187.8 英里，全部位于威斯康星州

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

value.en: About 72 miles southwest along the former State Trunk Highway 15 to I-90 near the Illinois line
value.zh: 沿原 15 号州干道向西南新增约 72 英里，直抵伊利诺伊州界附近的 I-90

figures.source: AARoads Interstate Guide, Interstate 43; AASHTO Route Numbering Committee agenda, 4 December 1987

why.en: No agency publishes a route-wide figure. The Wisconsin Department of Transportation counts traffic by segment, and much of the route's middle is concurrent with I-94 and I-894, where counts cannot be attributed to I-43 alone.
why.zh: 没有机构发布全线数字。威斯康星州交通部按路段统计交通量，而本路线中段大部分与 I-94、I-894 共线，其交通量无法单独归于 I-43。

timeline.en: I-43 first appears, on the former US 141 freeway from downtown Milwaukee north to Sheboygan.
timeline.zh: I-43 首次出现，标示在自密尔沃基市中心北至希博伊根的原 US 141 高速公路上。

timeline.en: The Rock Freeway between Beloit and the Milwaukee area is completed as State Trunk Highway 15, after seven years of construction.
timeline.zh: 伯洛伊特至密尔沃基地区的岩河快速路历时七年建成，编号为 15 号州干道。

timeline.en: The Milwaukee–Green Bay section is completed, giving I-43 its northern leg in full.
timeline.zh: 密尔沃基至格林贝路段建成，I-43 的北段全线贯通。

timeline.en: On 24 November the route numbering committee approves extending I-43 over I-94, I-894 and STH 15 to I-90 at Beloit.
timeline.zh: 11 月 24 日，路线编号委员会批准将 I-43 沿 I-94、I-894 与 STH 15 延伸至伯洛伊特的 I-90。

timeline.en: I-43 markers are posted along the new southern leg, giving the route its present extent.
timeline.zh: 新的南段竖起 I-43 标志，本路线形成今日的范围。
